column1: # babymodel-1.18.2.tsv — generated by tools/extract-babymodel.mjs from the 1.18.2 jar.
# ⚠ NOTHING HERE IS TYPED IN, INCLUDING WHAT THE COLUMNS MEAN: the six arguments were
#   matched to their roles by reading which field each one lands in and what the base
#   class's own render method then divides it by.  base=eim
# THE RULE (AgeableListModel.renderToBuffer, when young):
#   head group: if scaleHead, scale by 1.5 / babyHeadScale; then translate
#               (0, babyYHeadOffset/16, babyZHeadOffset/16) in BLOCKS
#   body group: scale by 1 / babyBodyScale; then translate (0, bodyYOffset/16, 0)
#   A poseStack scale followed by a translate means the offset is SCALED TOO:
#   a point p ends at s * (p + t), not s * p + t.
# UNREAD, and named rather than guessed: none — the QUEUE 0.2 (Tame/Breed remainder) pass
#   closed all 15 that were unread (D-497 area): tools/extract-babymodel.mjs's sixOf()/
#   headPartsOf() were generalized (see that file's own comments on the ctor-chain hop, the
#   Function-argument type filter, and the public-override read) to resolve AnimalModel's
#   own short-ctor defaults (chicken, wolf: the 0-arg/3-arg forms), BipedEntityModel's chain
#   (zombie, zombie_villager, drowned, armor_stand — armor_stand's "Small" flag IS its own
#   isBaby() override, ArmorStandEntity.isBaby() == isSmall(), so it takes this same branch),
#   and horse's own public getHeadParts() override.
# RULED NOT BABYABLE, and named rather than omitted silently: enderman giant vex — their
#   MODELS resolve fine (same BipedEntityModel plumbing as zombie) but LivingEntity.isBaby()
#   is `return false;` unconditionally and EndermanEntity/GiantEntity/VexEntity declare no
#   override (`grep -rl "public boolean isBaby()" .decomp/net/minecraft/entity/` finds only
#   LivingEntity, PassiveEntity, ZombieEntity, ParrotEntity, ArmorStandEntity), so
#   `LivingEntityRenderer`'s `model.child = entity.isBaby()` is always false for them and the
#   child branch never runs. See extract-babymodel.mjs's own NOT_BABYABLE citations.
# ⚠ PROVENANCE OF THE 12 ROWS BELOW (axolotl..zombie_villager, appended by the QUEUE 0.2
#   pass): this worker's machine has no javap (openjdk-11-jre-headless only, no JDK, no sudo
#   to install one), so extract-babymodel.mjs could not be RUN here to regenerate this file
#   end to end — SKIP - no javap on this machine is exactly what it prints (see its own guard).
#   These 12 rows were instead read BY HAND out of the same decompiled 1.18.2 source
#   (.decomp/net/minecraft/client/render/entity/model/{Axolotl,Bee,Cat,Chicken,Drowned,Fox,
#   Horse,Ocelot,Wolf,Zombie,ZombieVillager,ArmorStand}*.java, cited per row's own reasoning
#   in src/07j_entityrender.js's ER.BABY_OWED history) that the generalized extractor code was
#   traced BY HAND against to confirm it reaches the same six values (see sixOf's own docstring
#   for the chicken/wolf/zombie traces). Re-running `node tools/extract-babymodel.mjs` on a
#   machine with a full JDK should reproduce these 12 rows byte-for-byte; if it does not, that
#   disagreement is the bug to chase, not this file.
#   `:six` = its constructor does not pass six literals up; `:headGroup` = its head
#   group is not a plain field list; `:partNames` = its parts are not named by a literal.
